1.web: Job again took up his parable, and said,
1.asv: And Job again took up his parable, and said,

2.web: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
2.asv: Oh that I were as in the months of old, As in the days when God watched over me;

3.web: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,
3.asv: When his lamp shined upon my head, And by his light I walked through darkness;

4.web: as I was in the ripeness of my days, when the friendship of God was in my tent,
4.asv: As I was in the ripeness of my days, When the friendship of God was upon my tent;

5.web: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,
5.asv: When the Almighty was yet with me, And my children were about me;

6.web: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,
6.asv: When my steps were washed with butter, And the rock poured me out streams of oil!

7.web: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
7.asv: When I went forth to the gate unto the city, When I prepared my seat in the street,

8.web: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.
8.asv: The young men saw me and hid themselves, And the aged rose up and stood;

9.web: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
9.asv: The princes refrained from talking, And laid their hand on their mouth;

10.web: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.
10.asv: The voice of the nobles was hushed, And their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

11.web: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it commended me:
11.asv: For when the ear heardme, then it blessed me; And when the eye sawme, it gave witness unto me:

12.web: Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
12.asv: Because I delivered the poor that cried, The fatherless also, that had none to help him.

13.web: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
13.asv: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me; And I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

14.web: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
14.asv: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

15.web: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.
15.asv: I was eyes to the blind, And feet was I to the lame.

16.web: I was a father to the needy. The cause of him who I didn’t know, I searched out.
16.asv: I was a father to the needy: And the cause of him that I knew not I searched out.

17.web: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous, and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
17.asv: And I brake the jaws of the unrighteous, And plucked the prey out of his teeth.

18.web: Then I said, ‘I shall die in my own house, I shall number my days as the sand.
18.asv: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, And I shall multiply my days as the sand:

19.web: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.
19.asv: My root is spread out to the waters, And the dew lieth all night upon my branch:

20.web: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’
20.asv: My glory is fresh in me, And my bow is renewed in my hand.

21.web: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.
21.asv: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, And kept silence for my counsel.

22.web: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.
22.asv: After my words they spake not again; And my speech distilled upon them.

23.web: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.
23.asv: And they waited for me as for the rain; And they opened their mouth wideasfor the latter rain.

24.web: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.
24.asv: I smiled on them, when they had no confidence; And the light of my countenance they cast not down.

25.web: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
25.asv: I chose out their way, and sataschief, And dwelt as a king in the army, As one that comforteth the mourners.
